title: Light Eliminates L Forever in Part 2

series.summary: Light completes his master plan as Rem eliminates L, allowing Light to deceive the task force and take full command of the Kira investigation.

cuts.voiceover_text: L notices the Shinigami has vanished from the headquarters room. A chill settles over the atmosphere as he scans the empty space around him. Seconds earlier, Watari triggered an emergency data wipe before collapsing. Now L understands the terrifying truth. Rem is moving to protect Misa from execution. In the shadowy corner, the Shinigami opens the Death Note and writes L’s real name onto the page. Across the city, distant church bells echo only in L’s mind. A deep dread takes hold of him. He spins toward his computer screens in sudden panic. He opens his mouth to shout a warning to the team. But the strike has already landed.

A silver teaspoon slips from his trembling fingers and clatters loudly onto the hard floor. An excruciating sharp pain rips through his chest without mercy. The forty-second countdown has expired. His heart seizes violently without a single second of warning. L clutches desperately at his shirt in sheer agony as his vision begins to blur and darken. His knees buckle completely beneath him. The entire world slows to a crawl as his limp body tips sideways out of the chair. The detectives freeze in stunned disbelief at the shocking sight. Their brilliant lead investigator is collapsing helplessly right before their eyes, unable to utter a single final word.

Light lunges across the room and catches the dying detective in his arms before he strikes the hard floor. But as L looks up into his face, Light drops his innocent mask completely. A twisted, triumphant smirk spreads across Light’s mouth in full view of his dying rival. In that final quiet heartbeat, every piece of the puzzle snaps together. L’s greatest suspicion is confirmed at last. Light was Kira from the very beginning. His deductive brilliance was never wrong, yet ultimate victory slips from his grasp. With that devastating realization, L’s eyes lose their light, and he draws his last breath.

After secretly recovering Rem’s discarded notebook from the ashes, Light returns to face the shattered detectives. Panic grips the room as Matsuda cries out in terror that Kira will hunt them all down next. Light seizes the moment with calculated intensity and authority. He steps into the center of the room and forcefully silences their rising fear. He tells anyone afraid of dying to walk away from the task force right now. Then he raises his voice and swears a solemn oath to avenge Ryuzaki and solve the case no matter what. The grieving team rallies behind him in renewed loyalty, completely blind to the fact that they just placed Kira in charge.

Now crowned as the undisputed successor to L, Light stands in total command of the entire investigation. Every single threat against him has been completely eliminated. His greatest intellectual rival lies dead in the ground. The entire police task force follows his every command without question. Light smiles quietly into the darkness, knowing that no one left on earth can stop his absolute reign as the rightful God of the New World.
